whenToUse: A split button (Publish ▾), pager arrows, or an input attached to its button.
ToggleGroup for one-of or many-of view switches: Day/Week/Month, Bold/Italic.
avoidWhen: Unrelated actions side by side — use separate Buttons.
Picking one value inside a form — use Radio Group.
a11y: ButtonGroup is role=group with a label; ToggleGroup items expose pressed or checked state.
Icon-only items each need an aria-label and a Tooltip.
